screen: Review — three new directions on Northside's own file (second round)
job: A ledger of what is wrong in Northside's own price list, each finding with a priced fix that writes to the real file as one undoable step. Drawn on review() run on loadPack() on 2026-10-28: 53 lists, 15,691 lines. Registered as the wrong size: 9 of 430 trailers with a weight (7 Dunbier ALP and GFAB Offroad Sportskis heavier than Small, $819 not charged; 2 TINKA lighter than Large, $234 charged over). One name, two prices: 3 of 3,687 names (Mackay MLJ6000T-14-HB $21,223 / $21,633, PU5000-14-M $9,423 / $10,043, an Outboard Vented Cover $133 / $129). On sale, no price: the engine says 147, but it reads only a list's first price; read at every level a list declares, 46 remain (21 products blank at both Parts levels, 16 lines whose names say they are included or not supplied, and Formosa's 9 SRT 715 and 755 at $0 Cash, Trade and Warranty), and the boards draw 46 with that said on each. Two under one name: 4 columns (Dealer Fit's Code and CTD, Rigging Kits' Trade Price and Sub Dealer Price). Nothing to name it: 7 lines. Tidy: 138 linter suggestions that change no price. 7 lists (2,580 lines) declare no price and are not price-checked. Nothing is left as meant on day one. The only pictures are makers' marks held in marks-ledger.json. Every board uses the app's day tokens, copied from src/styles/tokens.css. Round 1's boards (A Reconcile, which was built; B The marked file; C The tally) are kept in round-1/, and none of this round's references is theirs.

directions.name: D · Check by check
directions.axis: Grouped by the kind of fault. A strip of six tabs across the top, one per check with its count, in what it costs (Wrong size 9 · Two prices 3 · No price 46 · Two under one name 4 · Nothing to name it 7 · Tidy 138, dashed). One check is open as a worktable: Line · What's wrong · As it reads · Will read ✎ · act, grouped by list and the list's own category. Drawn open on No price: Formosa's SRT with an empty Cash field and a sentence where Accept would be, the Lone Star kits with their priced neighbours beside the field, and the 4 factory-fit trailer plugs proposed as 'Leave as meant · It's meant' with Accept for 4.
directions.only: The fix is a cell the dealer can retype before it is written: the proposal is editable in place, beside the line as the price list reads it.

directions.name: E · The case queue
directions.axis: Grouped by what it costs, one case at a time. A rail counts 69 cases as ticks in five segments (and Tidy last), with $819 not charged and $234 charged over at its end. One 760px stage holds case 1: the fix as the title ('Register the ALP 5.3M-13B as a Large trailer.'), the file's own cells as evidence (as the price list reads · after the change), the source label and cell, one amber act 'Make it Large · +$117', Leave it with two reasons, Skip, and what is kept. Cases 2 and 3 peek beneath; the rest of the queue is one counted line.
directions.only: The price list is settled in one sitting, one priced case at a time with nothing else on screen, and the queue ends: its last case is the clean day.
references: docs/research/refs/review/live2/dependabot-create-update.png with live2/dependabot-dismiss.png — one product: the fix as the title, one act, reasons to leave (only E)
docs/research/refs/review/live/apple-iphone-storage.png — the act at the end, and what is kept said before it (only E)

directions.name: F · The settled statement
directions.axis: Grouped by state, read like a bank statement. One ruled sheet under Northside's mark: five sums ($819 · $234 · 46 · 11 · 0), then the checks as statement lines with Read · Lines · Too little · Too much, under four bands (Costs money with a subtotal, Could give a wrong pick, Found nothing, Left as meant), never netted, and a double-ruled closing balance 'Still to settle 69 · $819 · $234'. The wrong-size line is open into its nine items, each with its own small act; the foot names the 7 lists not checked.
directions.only: The file's health is an account that balances: what each check read, what is owed each way, and a closing balance that reads $0 and $0 on the clean day.
